decisions.reason: Making the two ticket counters and permanent badges visible in NFT metadata does not change the coded-referral commission or ticket award; that award is already recorded directly from the same message.
Metadata visibility does not alter ticket-counter independence, eligibility windows, or post-draw resets, and the candidate already records those mechanics directly from the same message.
Displaying the Big Block ticket counter in metadata does not change the Big Block prize amount, winner count, trigger, or eligible population.
Counter and badge visibility does not change random winner selection, ticket weighting, or winner eligibility.
Displaying the Small Block ticket counter in metadata does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner count, trigger, or eligible population.
Metadata visibility does not change the no-referral trigger, random ticket award, or recipient eligibility.
Showing ticket counters and permanent badges does not alter the rule that secondary-sale royalties fund prize pools.
NFT metadata presentation does not alter the requirement to enforce secondary-sale royalties.
Making counters and badges visible in metadata does not change the manual prize-claim workflow.
